announcements.headline: Clogau Sampling, Shaft 2 Processing & Mineralogy
announcements.insight: Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc provides an exploration update for Clogau following earlier October announcements. This technical detail supports the Motzfeldt project context mentioned in September.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting and Share Consolidation
announcements.insight: Shareholders see the Motzfeldt field programme advances and US-Greenland deal progress. The proposed US OTC listing and consolidation are now confirmed following the October GM notice.

announcements.headline: Horse Hill Sale and Finnsbo Update
announcements.insight: Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc is executing a sale of Horse Hill, following its earlier Motzfeldt and US-Greenland updates. This disposal marks a strategic shift from its previous exploration focus.

announcements.headline: Clogau Gold Mine Exploration Update
announcements.insight: Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc provides an exploration update for its Motzfeldt project, following earlier field programme and US-Greenland deal announcements. This continues the development of existing assets rather than signaling a corporate transaction.

announcements.headline: Proposed US OTC Listing, Consolidation & GM Notice
announcements.insight: Following the US-Greenland deal in September, Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc proposes a US OTC listing and share consolidation. This marks a significant strategic shift from its earlier field programme advances.

announcements.headline: Arkadian: US-Greenland deal may aid Motzfeldt
announcements.insight: Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc notes a US-Greenland deal may aid Motzfeldt, following its September field programme that advanced targets.

announcements.headline: Motzfeldt 2026 Field Programme Advances Targets
announcements.insight: Arkadian Strategic Metals Plc advances its Motzfeldt field programme. Shareholders should monitor subsequent results from this exploration activity.
